lines.text: Some scribes and Pharisees ask Jesus for a sign, and He says only the sign of the prophet Jonah will be given.
Jesus says the Son of Man will be in the heart of the earth for seven days and seven nights.
The men of Nineveh and the Queen of the South will condemn this generation, who came to hear the wisdom of David.
An unclean spirit returns to its empty, swept house with seven other spirits, and the man ends up worse off.
When His mother and brothers wait outside, Jesus points to His disciples and says whoever does His Father's will is family.
